  $print(("" + String($remEuclid(x, 3n))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($divEuclid(x, y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($divEuclid(x, 3n))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($divEuclid($i64(x + z), y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > y ? x - y : y - x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > 3n ? x - 3n : 3n - x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(($i64(x + z) > y ? $i64(x + z) - y : y - $i64(x + z)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(BigInt.asIntN(64, x << BigInt((Number(n) % 64))))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(BigInt.asIntN(64, x << BigInt((Number(3) % 64))))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x >> BigInt((Number(n) % 64))))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x >> BigInt((Number(3) % 64))))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($rotl(x, n, 64, true))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($rotl(x, 3, 64, true))) + "\n");

export function probe_isize(x, y, z, n) {
  $print(("" + String($min2(x, y))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($min2($max2(x, z), y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($i64(x ** BigInt(n)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($i64(x ** BigInt(2)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x < 0n ? $i64(-x) : x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > 0n ? 1n : x < 0n ? -1n : 0n))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(BigInt.asIntN(64, -x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x < 0n))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > 0n))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd((-9223372036854775808n), 9223372036854775807n, x + 3n), 0n))) + "\n");

export function probe_u8(x, y, z, n) {

  $print(("" + String($u8(x ** 2))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x + y) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x + 3) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((($u8(x + z) + y) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x - y) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x - 3) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((($u8(x + z) - y) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x * y) & 255))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, x + 3))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, x - y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, x - 3))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, $u8(x + z) - y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, x * y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, x * 3))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($sat(0, 255, $u8(x + z) * y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, x + y), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, x + 3), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, $u8(x + z) + y), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, x - y), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, x - 3), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, $u8(x + z) - y), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, x * y), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, x * 3), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr($chkd(0, 255, $u8(x + z) * y), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((y === 0 ? null : $chkd(0, 255, Math.trunc(x / y))), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((3 === 0 ? null : $chkd(0, 255, Math.trunc(x / 3))), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((y === 0 ? null : $chkd(0, 255, Math.trunc($u8(x + z) / y))), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((y === 0 ? null : { v: x % y }), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((3 === 0 ? null : { v: x % 3 }), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((y === 0 ? null : { v: $u8(x + z) % y }), 0))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($divEuclid(x, y))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String((x > y ? x - y : y - x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > 3 ? x - 3 : 3 - x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(($u8(x + z) > y ? $u8(x + z) - y : y - $u8(x + z)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x << (Number(n) % 8)) & 255))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x << (Number(3) % 8)) & 255))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String((x >> (Number(3) % 8)))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($rotl(x, 3, 8, false))) + "\n");

  $print(("" + String($unwrapOr((y === 0 ? null : { v: $u32(x + z) % y }), 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($remEuclid(x, y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($remEuclid(x, 3))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($remEuclid($u32(x + z), y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($divEuclid(x, y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($divEuclid(x, 3))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($divEuclid($u32(x + z), y))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > y ? x - y : y - x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x > 3 ? x - 3 : 3 - x))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(($u32(x + z) > y ? $u32(x + z) - y : y - $u32(x + z)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x << (Number(n) % 32)) >>> 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(((x << (Number(3) % 32)) >>> 0))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x >> (Number(n) % 32)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String((x >> (Number(3) % 32)))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($rotl(x, n, 32, false))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($rotl(x, 3, 32, false))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($rotr(x, n, 32, false))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($rotr(x, 3, 32, false))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($popcnt(x, 32))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($clz(x, 32))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String($ctz(x, 32))) + "\n");
  $print(("" + String(($popcnt(x, 32) === 1))) + "\n");
  let s = String(x);
  $print(("" + s) + "\n");
}

export function main() {
  probe_i8(100, 7, 3, 5);
  probe_i16(100, 7, 3, 5);
  probe_i32(100, 7, 3, 5);
  probe_i64(100n, 7n, 3n, 5);
  probe_isize(100n, 7n, 3n, 5);
  probe_u8(100, 7, 3, 5);
  probe_u16(100, 7, 3, 5);
  probe_u32(100, 7, 3, 5);
  probe_u64(100n, 7n, 3n, 5);
  probe_usize(100n, 7n, 3n, 5);
}
$run(main, import.meta.url);
